scope: ONE exact paper counterexample to universal W-monotone clock contraction; not a Wilf counterexample
runner_source:
import collections, hashlib, heapq, json, math, pathlib, signal, subprocess, time

signal.alarm(50)
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
L=304
delta=[1,3,8,12,18,22,27,29,30,43,50]
source=[63]+[63*L+x for x in delta]
groups={}
for t in range(1,64):
    raw=[n-(n+63-t)//63 for n in source]
    common=math.gcd(*raw)
    assert common==1
    key=tuple(n//common for n in raw)
    groups.setdefault(key,[]).append(t)
assert len(groups)==12
inputs=[source]+[list(G) for G in groups]
driver=r'''
#include "apery.hpp"
#include <iostream>
int main() {
  const std::vector<std::vector<wilf::i64>> cases{__CASES__};
  for(const auto& a:cases) {
    int m=static_cast<int>(a[0]);
    std::vector<wilf::i64> G(a.begin()+1,a.end());
    auto w=wilf::scan_cpu(m,G);
    auto b=wilf::invariants(m,G,w);
    if(!b.finite) return 2;
    std::cout << "{\"m\":" << m << ",\"e\":" << b.e
      << ",\"c\":" << b.c << ",\"g\":" << b.g
      << ",\"W\":" << b.W << ",\"w\":[";
    for(int i=0;i<m;++i) std::cout << (i?",":"") << w[i];
    std::cout << "]}\n";
  }
}
'''.replace('__CASES__',','.join('{'+','.join(map(str,G))+'}' for G in inputs))
(root/'clock496.cpp').write_text(driver)
start=time.perf_counter()
subprocess.run(['g++','-O2','-std=c++17',str(root/'clock496.cpp'),'-o',str(root/'clock496')],check=True,timeout=20)
compiled=time.perf_counter()
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in subprocess.check_output([str(root/'clock496')],text=True,timeout=10).splitlines()]
assert len(rows)==len(inputs)
for G,row in zip(inputs,rows):
    m=min(G)
    w=[10**30]*m;w[0]=0;heap=[(0,0)]
    while heap:
        dist,s=heapq.heappop(heap)
        if dist!=w[s]: continue
        for p in G:
            t=(s+p)%m
            if dist+p<w[t]:
                w[t]=dist+p;heapq.heappush(heap,(dist+p,t))
    assert w==row['w']
    assert all(x%m==i for i,x in enumerate(w))
    assert all(w[(s+p)%m]<=w[s]+p for s in range(m) for p in G)
    pred=[]
    for t in range(1,m):
        parents=[[(t-p)%m,p] for p in G if w[(t-p)%m]+p==w[t]]
        assert parents;pred.append([t]+parents[0])
    c=max(w)-m+1
    limit=c+max(G)+m
    member=[False]*(limit+1);member[0]=True
    for n in range(1,limit+1):
        member[n]=any(n>=p and member[n-p] for p in G)
    assert not member[c-1] and all(member[c:c+m])
    gaps=sum(not member[n] for n in range(c))
    minimal=[]
    for n in range(1,max(G)+1):
        if member[n] and not any(n>=p and member[n-p] for p in minimal):
            minimal.append(n)
    e=len(minimal);W=e*(c-gaps)-c
    assert (m,e,c,gaps,W)==tuple(row[k] for k in ['m','e','c','g','W'])
    assert gaps==sum(w[i]//m for i in range(1,m))
    row.update(supplied=G,minimal=minimal,ell=c-gaps,attainment=pred,
               independent_heap=True,membership_dp=True,edge_checks=m*len(G))
    if W<0: raise RuntimeError('independently verified negative actual W: '+str(row))
assert (rows[0]['m'],rows[0]['e'],rows[0]['c'],rows[0]['g'],rows[0]['W'])==(63,12,38322,34357,9258)
assert all(math.gcd(*(source[:i]+source[i+1:]))==1 for i in range(len(source)))
A=[0]+delta
pairs={r:min((a+b for a in A for b in A if (a+b)%63==r),default=None) for r in range(63)}
assert all(x is not None for x in pairs.values())
residual=[0 if r==0 else r if r in delta else pairs[r] for r in range(63)]
assert [r for r,s in enumerate(residual) if s>=63]==[5,7,10,14,17]
assert max(residual)==80 and sum(residual)==2268
for row in rows[1:]:
    G=row['supplied'];m=62;ts=groups[tuple(G)]
    residues=sorted({p%m for p in G[1:]}-{0})
    d=len(residues)
    h=[None]*m;h[0]=0;queue=collections.deque([0])
    while queue:
        s=queue.popleft()
        for a in residues:
            t=(s+a)%m
            if h[t] is None: h[t]=h[s]+1;queue.append(t)
    assert all(x is not None for x in h)
    H=max(h)
    s=[w-62*L*k for w,k in zip(row['w'],h)]
    assert all(0<=x<=50*k for x,k in zip(s,h))
    assert h[row['w'].index(max(row['w']))]==H
    coeff=d*m*H-(d+1)*sum(h)
    const=row['W']-L*coeff
    if d==10:
        assert ts==[1] or ts==[30]
        absent=3 if ts==[1] else 10
        assert all((a+b)%62!=absent for a in [0]+residues for b in [0]+residues)
        assert H>=3 and coeff>=59*H-110 and const>=-550*H-275
        lower=H*(59*L-550)-110*L-275
    else:
        assert d==11 and H>=2
        if H==2:
            wraps=sum(x//62 for x in s)
            assert max(s)>=61 and wraps<=39 and coeff==32 and const>=-468
            lower=32*L-468
        else:
            assert coeff>=82*H-132 and const>=-600*H-305
            lower=H*(82*L-600)-132*L-305
    assert row['W']>=lower>=9260>rows[0]['W']
    row.update(thresholds=ts,degree=h,height=H,nonmultiplicity_count=d,
               slope=coeff,constant=const,paper_lower_bound=lower)
end=time.perf_counter()
report={'scope':'ONE exact paper counterexample to universal W-monotone clock contraction; not a Wilf counterexample',
        'formula':'f_t(n)=n-floor((n+m-t)/m), t=1..m; divide common gcd',
        'host':'fejer CPU','cases':rows,'compile_seconds':compiled-start,
        'evaluation_and_independent_check_seconds':end-compiled,
        'threshold_count':63,'distinct_contractions':12,
        'minimum_contracted_W':min(r['W'] for r in rows[1:]),
        'source_deletion_cofactors_all_one':True,
        'source_residual':residual,
        'compiler':subprocess.check_output(['g++','--version'],text=True).splitlines()[0],
        'header_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'apery.hpp').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'runner_source':pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()}
(root/'clock_contraction_496.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k not in ['cases','runner_source','source_residual']}))
print(json.dumps([{k:r[k] for k in ['thresholds','e','c','g','W','height','slope','constant','paper_lower_bound']} for r in rows[1:]]))
